description: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis represents the epoch, ranging from 0 to 6, and the y-axis represents the WER, ranging from 25 to 42. The plot shows four lines representing different amounts of weights: small AdaLoRA_int4, small AdaLoRA_int8, small int4, and small int8. The small AdaLoRA_int4 line starts at 35 WER and ends at 30 WER, showing a steady decline. The small AdaLoRA_int8 line starts at 40 WER and ends at 30 WER, also showing a steady decline. The small int4 line starts at 30 WER and ends at 25 WER, showing a steady decline. The small int8 line starts at 35 WER and ends at 25 WER, showing a steady decline. Overall, the plot shows a decrease in WER as the epoch increases for all four lines.
